name: as.irts
title: The first column is the time and the remaining columns are the value.

origin.description: The first column is the time and the remaining columns are the value.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The series, matrix, or path this function accepts.

origin.details: The first column is the time and the remaining columns are the value.
origin.value: The same value tseries 0.10-63 returns for this case, written as one line.
origin.example:
ai <- as.irts(cbind(c(1, 2, 3), c(4, 5, 6)))
paste(join(as.numeric(time(ai))), join(value(ai)), sep = "|")
